name: Galaxy Buds Pro
author: Oleksii Lysenko (akafrmn), based on work by Aislan Dener Souza Vicentini
description: Samsung Galaxy Buds Pro, Buds2 Pro, Buds3 Pro and Buds4 Pro in the Omarchy bar: firmware updates without a phone, noise control, per-earbud and case battery with in-case status, low battery warnings, codec, 360 Audio, touch controls and quick connect.

barWidget.description: Switch noise modes, watch per-earbud battery and charging, pick the Bluetooth codec, and toggle 360 Audio, touch controls and quick connect. Controls the model does not have are hidden.

schema.label: Label overrides
schema.description: Replace any visible string, e.g. {"anc": "ANC", "ambient": "Som ambiente"}. Keys: noiseControl, settings, codec, off, anc, ambient, adaptive, spatial, touch, seamless, eq, eqOff, eqBass, eqSoft, eqDynamic, eqClear, eqTreble, eqCustom, left, right, case, inCase, ancOneBud, firmware, firmwareUpdate, firmwareMismatch, fwInstall, fwInstallNow, fwNotNow, fwNotReviewed, fwCancel, fwDismiss, fwConfirm, fwDownloading, fwOpening, fwWaiting, fwTransferring, fwInstalling, fwRebooting, fwDone, fwFailed, fwRefused, fwStepDownload, fwStepSend, fwStepInstall, fwStepRestart, fwLatest, fwChecked, fwChecking, fwUnknown, fwOf, fwAbout, fwLeft, notOutput, serviceOff, searchHint, searching, found, connectingDevice, search, pair, pluginLatest, pluginAvailable, pluginChecking, find, findRing, findStop, findWarning, findMuteLeft, findMuteRight, findWorn, findOffline, findAutoStop, findNotConnected, findUnsupported, findFirmware, findFirmwareStarted, findBothWorn, findUnknownPlacement, findNoneCanRing, findNoConfirm, findUnsafeUnmute, findTimeout, findBudsStopped.

schema.label: Low battery warning
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when either earbud drops to the threshold. Earbuds that are charging, in the case or not connected are ignored.

schema.label: Low battery threshold (%)
schema.description: Warn once either earbud falls to this percentage. Re-arms after it climbs 5% clear.

schema.label: Check for firmware updates
schema.description: Look up the newest Samsung build for your model in the community list at fw.timschneeberger.me (model name only, at most every 12 hours) and say when an update is available. An Install button then offers the update.

schema.label: Check for plugin updates
schema.description: Say next to the plugin version at the bottom of the panel whether it is the latest release. Looks up the newest release of this plugin on GitHub (api.github.com, plugin version only, at most every 12 hours). Click the notice to open the release; update with omarchy plugin update.
